name: Rider Speed
description: Shows each rider's live speed (plus optional speed delta and W/kg trend arrow) in the rider list, using biketerra-ride (~2Hz) for speed and btApp.riderController for W/kg trends.

settings.label: Show speed delta vs you
settings.description: Shows +/- speed difference relative to the focal rider.

settings.label: Show W/kg trend arrow
settings.description: Shows an up/down arrow when a rider's effort surges or eases.
